title: CodeDesignManifest
description: Validates docs/feature/{id}/design/code-design.manifest.yaml -- the broad DESIGN-OUT code-design contract (ADR-FLOW-003 D1 / DDD-1). It ABSORBS the existing component-manifest schema by $ref as a `component-manifest:` sub-object (ONE SSOT, no fork -- AT-A6), and adds the load-bearing `example-tables:` block (DDD-2). `signatures:`/`types:` are declared for forward-compatibility but NOT consumed by any gate yet (DDD-1 YAGNI).

schema-version.description: Schema version -- pinned to the single legal value until an ADR authorises a major bump.

component-manifest.description: The absorbed component-manifest contract (ONE SSOT -- referenced, never forked).

example-tables.description: The load-bearing example-table rows (DDD-2). Each row is the join key gate-G diffs against the AT `@row:` tags.

signatures.description: Forward-declared signature contracts (DDD-1 YAGNI -- declared, not consumed).

types.description: Forward-declared type contracts (DDD-1 YAGNI -- declared, not consumed).
